item.description:
• Search apps, files, commands, quicklinks, and system actions from one keyboard-first launcher
  • Clipboard history for text, images, files, links, and colors, with pinning and previews
  • Snippets that expand anywhere, with clipboard, date, and cursor placeholders
  • Calculator with units, time zones, dates, and live currency rates
  • AI with your own model: Apple Intelligence, any OpenAI-compatible API, or Ollama, with Quick AI, AI Chat, and AI Commands
  • Colored sticky notes on your desktop with Markdown and checklists
  • Capture text from anywhere on screen and scan QR codes and barcodes
  • Window management, emoji search, dictionary, and today's schedule
  • Runs Script Commands and many Raycast extensions with native views
